Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You sit beside the patient and patiently coax their exhausted body back toward its own rhythm.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
One hour per attempt; at most once per wound per day.
Target / range / shape
One wound listing Life treatment; one hour
Duration
Recovery progress persists for that wound; completed treatment removes only its listed treatable penalties.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Each wound can be treated only once per day across all healers.
Type
Recovery

Choose one wound that lists Life treatment. Spend one hour treating it, then roll Reason and add recovery progress:

Weak
Add 1 recovery progress.
Standard
Add 2 recovery progress.
Strong
Add 3 recovery progress.

Keep a running total for that wound. When the total reaches its recovery value, remove only the penalties it lists as treatable by this method. The scar and accumulated wound count remain. This restores no HP, regrows no missing body part and replaces no lost equipment. The same wound may be treated only once per day, even by different healers.

Source: design/cards/treat-life-injury.md at 9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3.
